name: Prabashini Mahakuda

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Prabashini Mahakuda, also published as Pravasini Mahakud, is an Odia poet and translator associated with Kalahandi, Odisha. Her work moves between writing poetry and bringing other poets into Odia. Sahitya Akademi published her translation of K. Satchidanandan’s poems as Hajijaithiba Zinisha O Anyanya Kabita. At its Festival of Letters in 2020, she described translation as a creative act that carries one culture into conversation with another.

“In This Body” gathers the weight of a life into flesh, memory and interrupted dreams. Its central figure asks the morning for relief from loneliness and grief, then imagines someone strong enough to share the burden. The poem makes bodily weariness a way of speaking about the need for companionship.
